formula: Q_meas(t) = mu(t) * (L/v(t) - L/v_f), zero where not congested

queue_discarded_outside_episodes.why_that_number_misleads: It is a bin-count effect. Outside bins outnumber inside ones 16.7 to 1 while carrying 14x less each.
queue_discarded_outside_episodes.outside_baseline_is_an_artefact: v_f is a 95th percentile, so 95% of bins sit just below it and L/v - L/v_f is a small positive number almost everywhere. That floor is not queue.
queue_discarded_outside_episodes.verdict: The 0.70 cut-off is conservative against the threshold-free breakdown at 0.82 v_f found in step 2, but what the boundary clips amounts to about 6% of what it captures. Not worth moving the threshold for.
